simple.summary: מַחְסֵיָה (Machçêyâh) means Machsejah , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Jer 32 12.

definitions.full: H4271. Machseyah מַחְסֵיָה proper name, masculine ( ׳י is a refuge ) ancestor of Baruch and Seraiah Jer 32:12 (Baer ׳מַחֲס ) 51:59 .
definitions.rootNote: from 4268 and 3050 ; refuge of (i.e. in) Jah;
